title: Look Twice Before Scanning Public QR Codes
body: Attackers sometimes paste fake QR stickers over restaurant menus or parking meters ('Qishing'). Always preview the destination web address in Cyber Companion before entering any personal info.
actionableTakeaway: Use the QR Verification Sandbox before opening unfamiliar QR links.

title: Avoid Banking on Open Public Wi-Fi
body: Free Wi-Fi at cafes or airports without a password ('Open' encryption) allows nearby devices to intercept unencrypted traffic.
actionableTakeaway: Check Wi-Fi encryption with the Wi-Fi Risk Analyzer or switch to mobile data for sensitive logins.

title: Audit Apps Asking for SMS or Microphone Access
body: A simple flashlight, calculator, or wallpaper app never needs access to your text messages, contacts, or microphone.
actionableTakeaway: Review high-risk permissions monthly using the App Permissions Auditor.

title: Spot Urgent Delivery & Bank Text Scams
body: Smishing messages create artificial urgency—like a 'suspended account' or 'missed package fee'—to rush you into tapping a counterfeit link.
actionableTakeaway: Paste suspicious text links into the Malicious URL Scanner before tapping.
